label: font-preload-experiment
methodology: Cold browser context and disabled cache for every navigation; CDP applied network and CPU throttling; one page at a time; 1.5 seconds of observation after fonts settle. External GET requests receive a fixed settings response after 100 ms; POSTs are blocked. Local production preview, not a deployed-host or Lighthouse score. Bytes are encoded resource response bodies, without HTTP headers. Observed blocking time sums long-task time over 50 ms after FCP until the end of the load observation window; not Lighthouse simulated TBT. Modal timing measures click-to-visible dialog plus two animation frames.
